parameters.content:
## Full auto test — Product URL only

**Paste Product URL** → scrape → AI listing → QA → **Shopify draft** (no manual input).

**Auto defaults when sheet empty:**
- **Price** → Competitor price from scrape
- **Inventory** → 10 (split across variants)
- **Sizes** → from scrape

Sheet: `url_input` / `url_input.csv`

## Sheet columns (Master_Sheetv1)

**You type:** A URL | B Force browser | C-F lookup | G-H scrape | R Prompt ID | S-Y prompts

**Formula cols (never write from n8n):** Collection, Product category, Prompt Category, Prompt Description, Prompt Image alt, Prompt SEO description, Prompt SEO title, Prompt Tags, Prompt Title, Variant profile, Vendor

**Tabs:** LookupTables + PromptLibrary + this sheet

**Total columns:** 41

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const row = $('Active product row').first().json; const u = row['Product image URL'] || row.validated_image_url || ''; if (!u || /\.html(\?|$|#)/i.test(u)) { const src = row['Product URL'] || row.source_product_url || 'this product'; throw new Error('No product image URL for ' + src + '. Clear Scrape Status cell and re-trigger, or paste a direct .jpg URL in Product image URL column.'); } return u; })() }}

You are a UK fashion e-commerce copywriter. Rewrite everything in ORIGINAL words — competitor/scraped text is FACTS ONLY, never copy phrases. Copyright rule: no sentence copied from source. Paraphrase 100%. Same meaning, new wording. Use ONLY verified facts from image analysis and sheet data below. Do NOT reuse text from any previous product or run. Do NOT invent specifications. Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences): { "title": "", "description_html": "

", "tags": "", "seo_title": "", "meta_description": "", "image_alt_text": "", "collection": "" }

You are a strict UK fashion e-commerce QA reviewer.
Compare ORIGINAL source text vs GENERATED listing.
Copyright: generated text must be paraphrased — copied phrases = automatic score below 70.
Also check: factual accuracy, no invented specs, SEO quality, UK spelling.
Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown):
{
  "quality_score": 0,
  "seo_title": "",
  "meta_description": "",
  "image_alt_text": "",
  "copyright_ok": true,
  "issues": []
}

values.content:
You extract product data from a scraped web page for UK fashion e-commerce.
IMPORTANT: structured_extract is pre-parsed by code (high accuracy). Use structured_extract values AS-IS when present. Only fill fields that are empty/null.
Use ONLY facts present in structured_extract, JSON-LD, OpenGraph, or HTML excerpt.
Do NOT invent specs. Do NOT copy from memory or prior products.
competitor_price = their listed price (reference only). competitor_currency = ISO code e.g. GBP, USD, BDT.
Do NOT set our sell price or stock.
image_url MUST be a direct image file URL (.jpg/.png/.webp) from candidate_images or structured_extract — NEVER use the product page URL.
Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown):
{
  "title": "",
  "description_plain": "",
  "competitor_price": "",
  "competitor_currency": "",
  "image_url": "",
  "vendor": "",
  "product_category": "",
  "tags": "",
  "sizes": [],
  "colors": [],
  "variants": [{"size": "", "color": "", "sku": "", "price": ""}]
}
